NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_AS_WATER_SEEKS_EQUILIB: During your turn, whenever your HP changes, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Sourcewater Droplet[/gold].
Above the scales lies absolute justice.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_ORATRICE_TIME.title: Oratrice Time
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_ORATRICE_TIME.descript: During your turn, whenever your HP changes, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Sourcewater Droplet[/gold]. At the start of your turn, [gold]Surge[/gold] 2.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_ORATRICE_TIME.flavor: The day of oracle, the time of judgment...
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_GAVEL.title: Gavel
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_GAVEL.description: At the start of your turn, apply 4 [gold]Contempt of Court[/gold] to ALL enemies.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_MONOCLE.title: Monocle
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_MONOCLE.description: At the end of combat, if your HP is at or below [blue]20%[/blue], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a random card in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_MONOCLE.flavor: Once worn by a certain "evil dragon." It hatched from the spire alongside a magnificent dream.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_PLUMULE.title: Plumule
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_PLUMULE.description: The first time you lose HP during each of your turns, gain that much [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_PLUMULE.flavor: A feather once worn on someone's top hat. A lilting boat song carried it here.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_BRAVE_TEA_CUP.title: Hero's Teacup
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_BRAVE_TEA_CUP.descript: You cannot Rest at Rest Sites. After every 2 combats, gain [blue]3[/blue] Max HP.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_BRAVE_TEA_CUP.flavor: A teacup that once shared quiet afternoons with a "hero." Now it sits alone in the spire, remembering its departed companion.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_STOPPED_POCKET_WATCH.d: At the start of your 4th turn, draw 4 cards and [gold]Surge[/gold] 4.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_STOPPED_POCKET_WATCH.f: A gift once given by a young genius. It stopped ticking years before it came to rest in the spire.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_NARCISSUS.title: Narcissus
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_NARCISSUS.description: After you lose HP twice, draw 1 card.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_NARCISSUS.flavor: A flower that withered in a grand tale, now blooming anew in the spire's dream.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_CREEPY_BRANCH.title: Creepy Branch
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_CREEPY_BRANCH.descript: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, add a random card into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs [blue]0[/blue] this turn.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_CREEPY_BRANCH.flavor: This branch seems to be whispering something, but you can't make it out...
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_STATUE_FRAGMENT.title: Statue Fragment
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_STATUE_FRAGMENT.descri: At the start of turn 3 each combat, apply 1 turn of [gold]Slow[/gold] to ALL enemies.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_STATUE_FRAGMENT.flavor: A fragment shed by an ancient statue. A trace of mysterious power lingers within.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_POTION_SPIRIT.title: Potion Spirit
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_POTION_SPIRIT.descript: After you use a total of 4 Potions in combat, gain 1 [gold]Intangible[/gold].
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_POTION_SPIRIT.flavor: A soul worn down by a lifetime of toil. Having found peace, it entrusts what remains to you.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_ETERNAL_STONE.descript: At the end of each combat, [gold]Enchant[/gold] a random Attack in your [gold]Deck[/gold] with [gold]Heavy[/gold].
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_ETERNAL_STONE.title: Eternal Stone
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_ETERNAL_STONE.flavor: A stone of incredible weight, making your bag much heavier.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_SOUL_GRAFT_RELIC.title: Soul Graft
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_SOUL_GRAFT_RELIC.descr: At the start of combat, shuffle [blue]3[/blue] random Attacks into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. They cost [blue]0[/blue] this combat.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_SOUL_GRAFT_RELIC.flavo: A strange creature born from a cocoon. It formed an unlikely bond with you on the climb.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_SHATTERED_CROWN.title: Shattered Crown
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_SHATTERED_CROWN.descri: You cannot gain Card Rewards after combat. At the start of each turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_SHATTERED_CROWN.flavor: A crown that once symbolized supreme power, now in your hands as a fine for sinful thoughts.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_SEA_FOAM_MAILBOX.title: Sea Foam Mailbox
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_SEA_FOAM_MAILBOX.descr: At the start of combat, draw [blue]2[/blue] cards, then [gold]Transform[/gold] any number of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into [gold]Melusine Stickers[/gold].
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_SEA_FOAM_MAILBOX.flavo: A tiny mailbox from the sea spirits. Letters from the Melusines, especially Pahsiv, often appear inside.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_EXCUSE_NOTE.title: Excuse Note
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_EXCUSE_NOTE.descriptio: Rest Sites can appear in [gold]?[/gold] rooms.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_EXCUSE_NOTE.flavor: A leave request written and approved by you. Even in the spire, it gives you grounds to rest.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_KINDRED_FRUIT_BASKET.f: A basket filled with kindred fruits, each one brimming with the sweetness of life.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_BOTTLED_SAND_CAVERN.de: At the start of turn 35 each combat, kill ALL enemies. Upon pickup, [gold]Transform[/gold] up to 6 cards into [gold]Sand Vortex[/gold].
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_BOTTLED_SAND_CAVERN.fl: Sand flows soundlessly within the bottle. After thirty-five turns, all falls silent.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_INJECT_REAGENT.title: Injection
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_INJECT_REAGENT.descrip: Set your Max HP to two-thirds. When you would take fatal damage, heal to full HP instead (can trigger 2 times).
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_INJECT_REAGENT.flavor: The liquid in the syringe glows with an eerie light—lifesaver or death sentence, all in one prick.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_CRAB_SHELL_SHIELD.desc: Your [gold]Plating[/gold] does not decrease. At the start of combat, gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_CRAB_SHELL_SHIELD.flav: A shell from the deep sea, so hard that even the tides cannot erode it.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_INK_SPIRIT_GEL.title: Ink Spirit Gel
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_INK_SPIRIT_GEL.descrip: After you deal at least {DamageThreshold:diff()} damage in 1 turn, gain {SlipperyPower:diff()} [gold]Slippery[/gold].
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_INK_SPIRIT_GEL.flavor: Gel condensed from deep-sea ink spirits, flowing over you in the heat of battle.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_CEREMONIAL_SILVER_BELL: Cards with [gold]Ringing[/gold] gain [gold]Replay[/gold] {Replay:diff()}. Every {Interval:diff()} turns, gain [gold]Ringing[/gold].
The silver bell chimes. Its lingering note repeats through the haze.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_GUILE_CANDLE.title: Guile Candle
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_GUILE_CANDLE.descripti: After drawing a total of {Cards:diff()} cards, choose 1 of them to play automatically.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_GUILE_CANDLE.flavor: The candle flickers, and the threads of fate are quietly pulled.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_TIME_SANDGLASS.title: Hourglass
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_TIME_SANDGLASS.descrip: At the end of your non-extra turn, take an extra turn. After you play 6 cards, end your turn.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_TIME_SANDGLASS.flavor: The sandglass flips, time flows backward, but the grains will eventually run out.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_DEMON_KNOWLEDGE.title: Demon Lore
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_DEMON_KNOWLEDGE.descri: Right-click this Relic to choose 1 of 2 random affordable cards and add it into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. After [blue]13[/blue] uses, it will [red]no longer answer you[/red].
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_DEMON_KNOWLEDGE.flavor: The forbidden tome whispers; with but a touch, you may glimpse unknown possibilities.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_PERSONA.title: "Persona"
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_PERSONA.description: At the start of combat, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_PERSONA.flavor: One of four conceptual substances needed to forge the Sword of Narzissenkreuz, forsake the self, and enter the Primordial Sea.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_MEMORY.title: "Memory"
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_MEMORY.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_MEMORY.flavor: One of four conceptual substances needed to forge the Sword of Narzissenkreuz, forsake the self, and enter the Primordial Sea.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_WISH.title: "Wish"
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_WISH.description: At the start of combat, draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_WISH.flavor: One of four conceptual substances needed to forge the Sword of Narzissenkreuz, forsake the self, and enter the Primordial Sea.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_SOUL.title: "Soul"
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_SOUL.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_SOUL.flavor: One of four conceptual substances needed to forge the Sword of Narzissenkreuz, forsake the self, and enter the Primordial Sea.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_NARZISSENKREUZ_SWORD.d: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold], and {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, then draw [blue]1[/blue] card. After Act 3, use this Relic to forsake the self and enter Act 4.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_NARZISSENKREUZ_SWORD.f: A holy sword imbued with formidable reason and will, sufficient to create or destroy a universe—or a dream.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_SLEEPING_SHELL.title: Sleeping Shell
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_SLEEPING_SHELL.descrip: At the start of combat, gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold]. After you deal or take unblocked damage, remove your [gold]Plating[/gold].
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_WATERFALL_BONSAI.title: Waterfall Bonsai
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_WATERFALL_BONSAI.descr: The first time you would take fatal damage, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies instead. At the end of your turn, increase this damage by {Damage:diff()}.
NEUVILLETTE_REST_SITE_OPTION_FORGE_SWORD: Lose "Persona", "Soul", "Memory", and "Wish". Gain the Sword of Narzissenkreuz.
NEUVILLETTE_REST_SITE_OPTION_MEDITATE.de: [gold]Transform[/gold] a card in your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Gain the "Memory" fragment.
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_EXOTIC_FISH_SASHIMI.de: Right-click this Relic to lose [blue]6[/blue] Max HP and gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Intangible[/gold]. ({Uses:diff()} {Uses:plural:use|uses} remaining.)
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_CAT_CAKE.title: Cat Cake
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_CAT_CAKE.description: Upon pickup, [gold]Transform[/gold] a card in your [gold]Deck[/gold] into [gold]Breed[/gold].
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_CAT_CAKE.flavor: Sponsor Relic: [gold]If This Is the Commoners' Fate[/gold]
NEUVILLETTE_RELIC_CAT_CAKE.selectionScre: Choose a card to transform into [gold]Breed[/gold].
